subject: Medford Square District Zoning Amendment
overview: The Medford Community Development Board reviewed site plan applications for a retail conversion at 85 Main Street and a new Tufts University aquatic center, continuing both public hearings. The board also voted to recommend city council adoption of the revised Medford Square District Zoning Amendment.

items.title: 85 Main Street Site Plan Review
items.summary: The board continued the public hearing for site plan review to convert a motor vehicle repair establishment into a neighborhood retail store at 85 Main Street to May 6, 2026.

items.title: Tufts Aquatic Center Site Plan Review
items.summary: The board heard a presentation on Tufts University's proposed 45,800-square-foot aquatic center at 130 College Avenue and continued the Dover Amendment site plan review to May 6, 2026.

items.title: Medford Square District Zoning Amendment
items.summary: After reviewing revised draft language regarding building step backs, height calculations, and historic preservation incentives, the board voted to recommend that the City Council adopt the zoning amendment text and map.

items.title: Administrative Business and Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Staff introduced new Economic Development Director John Ahumada and discussed advance notification procedures for board filings before the board approved previous meeting minutes.
